venue_types.restaurant: Sit-down or counter-service restaurants, food trucks, taquerias, BBQ, pizza, sushi, diners
venue_types.coffee shop: Coffee houses, tea houses, cafes whose primary product is coffee/tea drinks
venue_types.fast food: National/regional quick-service chains (drive-thru style): McDonald's, Raising Cane's, Freddy's
venue_types.bakery: Bakeries, donut shops, kolache shops, ice cream / dessert shops
venue_types.bar: Bars, pubs, breweries, wine bars, saloons, lounges
venue_types.hotel: Hotels, resorts, motels, cabins, vacation rentals, spas attached to lodging
venue_types.travel: Cruise lines, ferries, travel agencies, tour operators, car rental, RV/campervan rental
venue_types.gas station: Fuel stations and fuel-centric travel centers
venue_types.convenience store: Convenience stores, corner stores, food marts (non-fuel or fuel-secondary)
venue_types.retail: Physical retail stores: clothing, sporting goods, electronics, thrift, books, hardware/building supply
venue_types.subscription/saas: Software, streaming, memberships, online services billed recurringly
venue_types.utility: Power, water, gas, telecom, internet, waste disposal
venue_types.medical: Doctors, dentists, hospitals, pharmacies, labs, imaging, therapy
venue_types.financial: Banks, card payments, transfers, brokerages, insurance, wires, fees
venue_types.government: Government agencies, DMV/DPS, tolls, parking authorities, libraries, courts, schools' districts
venue_types.education: Schools, tutoring, courses, educational platforms, school boosters/PTAs
venue_types.entertainment: Theaters, cinemas, theme parks, arcades, concerts, sports venues, ticketing
venue_types.sports/fitness: Gyms, sports leagues, tournaments, camps, athletic facilities, swim/basketball programs
venue_types.personal care: Salons, barbers, nails, spas (non-lodging), dry cleaners
venue_types.home services: Contractors, roofers, septic, pest control, landscaping, surveying, movers
venue_types.professional services: Lawyers, accountants, filing agents, consultants, printing
venue_types.not-a-venue: Not a place of business: transfers, payments, interest, payroll, crypto, reimbursements
venue_types.unknown: Could not be identified even after web search
